sections.heading: Avril Lavigne — Early Life, Family and Education

Public records name her mother, Judith Rosanne Loshaw. She is a sibling of Michelle Lavigne, Matthew Lavigne, Michelle Lavigne and Matthew Lavigne.
Her listed education includes Napanee District Secondary School.
She is recorded as speaking English and French.
